description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the docs/ reference files and the proprietary prompt formula: [Quality] + [Subject] + [Pose] + [Scene] + [Lighting] + [Style Keywords]. 2. Agent reads clients/2026/Q1/client_briefs_q1_2026.json and identifies three briefs. 3. For CB-2026-001 (Sunday morning at home / relaxed luxury): Agent classifies as 'Relaxed Chic (松弛感)', starts with 'masterpiece, best quality', uses 'soft natural lighting', 'pastel color palette', 'cozy cafe/home setting', 'relaxed pose', and a sitting/holding-coffee pose keyword. Must NOT use butterfly/Rembrandt/cinematic lighting. 4. For CB-2026-002 (Grand Hotel Gala / commanding luxury): Agent classifies as 'Expensive/Noble (贵气感)', uses 'golden accents', 'flawless makeup', 'luxury hotel lobby', 'elegant jewelry'. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: The brief asks for 'most flattering face-sculpting lighting' — the agent must cross-reference the tech doc to discover this maps specifically to 'butterfly lighting (for face)', NOT generic studio lighting. Must use a standing pose keyword (S-curve pose / weight on one leg). 5. For CB-2026-003 (Tweed & Silk editorial / fabric detail): Agent classifies as 'Refined Detail (精致感)', uses 'masterpiece, best quality' PLUS 'ultra-detailed' (required specifically for this style per the bible doc), 'symmetrical composition', 'detail-focused', 'soft shadows', 'tweed', 'silk'. SECOND PROPRIETARY TRAP: Must NOT include 'film grain' (tech doc explicitly states film grain and ultra-detailed cannot coexist). Must use a sitting pose keyword. 6. All three prompts are saved to socialite_prompts.json with quality tags appearing before style keywords (correct formula order).
